detail.longDescription:
Social networks are great for discovery, but terrible for finding something again.

Hister turns Bluesky posts, @Mastodon@mastodon.social toots, tweets, Reddit threads, and @Discourse@mastodon.social topics into a private full text archive you can search across platforms.

Read how it works: https://hister.org/posts/how-hister-makes-the-social-web-searchable

#Hister #SelfHosted #Privacy
